data.name: Qamarah
data.gender_notes: Qamarah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Qamarah means 'moonlight' and is derived from the Arabic word 'Qamar', which means 'moon'. The name Qamarah carries the meaning “Moonlight” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in English, Urdu, Hindi. Parents who choose Qamarah usually hope their child will grow to embody moonlight and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Carrying the softness, calmness, and grace of the moon, a person named Qamarah is believed to be spiritually connected to the lunar energies.
data.etymology: Qamarah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Moonlight.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Qamarah total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_arabic.name: قمرة
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم علم مؤنث من أصل عربي، مشتق من كلمة قمر، ويعني الضوء أو النور الذي يأتي من القمر، ويرمز إلى الجمال والرقة. ورد ذكر القمر في القرآن الكريم في عدة سور، منها سورة يونس وسورة يس وسورة الفرقان، وله دلالات روحية عميقة في الإسلام.

in_urdu.name: قمرہ
in_urdu.long_meaning: عربی मूल کا ایک علم نام ہے، جو چاند یا چاند کی روشنی سے ماخوذ ہے۔ یہ نام اسلامی تقویم میں چاند کی اہمیت اور اس کی روشنی کی علامت ہے۔ اردو زبان میں یہ نام لڑکیوں کے لئے مقبول ہے، اور اس کا مطلب ہے خوبصورت اور منور۔

in_hindi.name: कमरा
in_hindi.long_meaning: यह एक सुंदर और अर्थपूर्ण नाम है, जो चाँद की रोशनी से जुड़ा हुआ है। इस नाम का अर्थ है उजला, चमकदार और आकर्षक। इस्लामी परंपरा में, चाँद की रोशनी को आध्यात्मिक ज्ञान और शांति का प्रतीक माना जाता है।

in_pashto.name: قمره
in_pashto.meaning: د چاند یا د چاند رڼا
in_pashto.long_meaning: د پښتو ژبې يو نوم دی، چي د چاند يا د چاند د رڼا څخه مشتق شوی دی. دا نوم د افغان او پښتون کلتور کې د ښځو لپاره کارول کیږي، او د ښکلا او نورمګرۍ نښه ده.

in_english.name: Qamarah
in_english.long_meaning: Qamarah is a beautiful and meaningful name derived from the Arabic word 'qamar', which means 'moon' or 'moonlight'. In Islamic tradition, the moon is a significant celestial body, often associated with guidance, light, and spiritual growth. The name Qamarah symbolizes beauty, elegance, and illumination.

pronunciation.pashto: په پښتو کې د تلفظ تفصیل: قمره

data.cultural_impact: The Islamic name Qamarah holds significant cultural importance in the Arab world and beyond due to various reasons. From a visual perspective, the name evokes beautifully the gentle and calming effect of moonlight on the earth. It represents a time of peace and tranquility. Furthermore, it is a reminder of the natural beauty that exists in the world and the importance of preserving it.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Qamarah holds great significance in Islamic culture. The moon is often seen as a symbol of God's guidance, as mentioned in the Quran, "And indeed We have explained in this Qur'an every kind of parable in detail, with allowance [given] to the believers in their religious commitments, and not to the disbelievers among the peoples of the Scriptures. And enough for them is the Clear Verses of Our messages [which makes it] clear to God-consciousness." (Quran 12:111).
